items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And in the Embers restaurant, jazz place, there was the trio with Red Norvo, the vibraphonist... I went to listen.

ctx.x: So Toots, when you say you were ill, what disease did you have?

Asthma and pneumonia. And I still have to be careful for asthma. In my life, I went through the total scope of asthma puffs and even… oh, that’s a beautiful anecdote. Even when I came to the States the first time. That was in ’47, with my uncle, the brother of my father. And we went… There was a club—The Embers. I wound up playing there with the George Shearing Quartet. And I went to listen. I knew all the records. I was up on all my bebop.
